title: Biased derivative as a scaled derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in\mathbb R$, let $i$ be one of the $n$ coordinates, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The biased discrete derivative of $f$ in coordinate $i$ is the function obtained by multiplying its ordinary discrete derivative by the square root of $4p(1-p)$ at every point of the cube.
